ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (beige/white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity beige zones occupy the central regions of both lobes. These are bordered by low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edges and the median notch area. Dark vertical streaks and mottling are superimposed on the beige zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with jagged peaks and valleys (1-5 pixel amplitude) along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature observed along the trailing edges of both lobes leading toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, white/grey high-contrast pixel rosettes (barnacles) localized at the distal fluke tips and scattered across the dark-pigmented upper sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically on the right lobe and intersecting diagonally on the lower beige region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips and numerous circular 'ring' scars distributed across the beige pigment zones.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of large, distinct hollow-circle scar patterns (approximately 5-10 visible) on the high-intensity beige regions of both lobes.
